verdict.rationale: USCIS is a government immigration-services portal with a narrow developer API platform (Case Status and FOIA APIs, sandbox, production keys). It does not host user-defined automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. The Torch sandbox is a test-data environment, not version control or rollback for automations, and nothing in the evidence shows USCIS shipping such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
